auth.aside.body: One account, every competition on the board, and tools that keep betting in its place. This platform runs on credits — no real money moves.
auth.aside.demoNotice: Balances are demonstration credits, not money, and no identity or age verification takes place. Do not enter real personal data you are not comfortable sharing.
auth.field.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with upper case, lower case and a digit
auth.login.title: Sign in
auth.login.description: Pick up where you left off.
auth.register.title: Create an account
auth.register.description: It takes a minute. You must be of legal age.
auth.register.submitted: Form validated. No account was created — this is a demonstration, and a real sign-up would now require email confirmation and identity verification before the account could be used.
auth.forgot.title: Reset your password
auth.forgot.description: Enter your email address and we’ll send you a reset link.
auth.forgot.submitted: If that address has an account, a reset link has been issued. If you don’t receive it, contact support — they can issue one for you.
auth.age.heading: Age restriction
auth.age.confirm: I confirm that I am {age} years of age or older
auth.age.notVerification: This is a self-declaration, not age verification. A licensed provider must confirm your date of birth against an authoritative source before any account could place a real bet or make a deposit.
